infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used for QR code scanning during server setup and for attaching photos to your Claude Code sessions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to attach photos from your library to your Claude Code sessions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Threadbase needs the microphone to dictate prompts.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Threadbase converts your speech to text on-device.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Threadbase to access your camera for QR code scanning.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Threadbase to attach photos from your library to Claude Code sessions.

plugins.microphonePermission: Threadbase needs the microphone to dictate prompts.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Threadbase converts your speech to text on-device.
